page: Google Cloud Platform a3-highgpu-2g is an accelerator-optimized server configured with two NVIDIA H100 GPUs based on the Hopper architecture, delivering a total of 160 GB of VRAM. The host system is powered by an Intel Xeon 8481C processor with 52 vCPUs (26 physical cores) running at 2.7 GHz, supported by 468 GB of system memory. Local storage is provided via a 1608 GB NVMe SSD.

Benchmark results indicate top-tier performance in LLM inference workloads, with prompt processing speeds reaching 10254.62 tokens per second for a 135M model and 5644.37 tokens per second for a 7B model. Memory bandwidth is strong, measuring 3828.33 GB/sec for cached read-only small blocks and 214.57 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Multi-threaded decompression and software compilation benchmarks also register strong performance, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 54314.03.

Given its high-density accelerator configuration and substantial memory allocation, this server offers qualitative cost efficiency for specialized, resource-intensive workloads where GPU throughput is the primary bottleneck. It is highly suited for large language model inference, deep learning training, high-performance database operations, and complex scientific simulations.
